description: Inspect several documents of ONE case together (for example three months of bank statements, or a payslip and the statement it was paid into) and report what one file at a time cannot show: inconsistencies BETWEEN them. Each document gets the same report inspect_document returns; on top, the case reports `same-file` (the identical file sent twice), `same-base-file` (different files that keep one base file's permanent /ID or its whole set of font subset tags, which is what editing one real statement into several months leaves behind) and `shared-creation-instant` (different files created in the same second). These are inconsistencies to review, never verdicts: each has benign causes, and two genuine statements of the same bank are not flagged for sharing a template. Retention follows the key's account (a key set to `none` keeps nothing). Needs an API key; a case of N documents costs N.

paths.description: Absolute paths to the documents on this machine. Max 10 MB each. Together with urls: 2 to 10 documents. In the result, documents are numbered paths first, then urls, in the order given.

urls.description: http:/https: URLs to fetch documents from. Fetched LOCALLY over this machine's network (not from the Tamperlens server); http/https only, redirects re-checked, max 10 MB each on the bytes received. Numbered after paths.

name: inspect_case
